title: Universal strong Kadison–Kastler stability
summary: We prove that sufficiently close unital von Neumann algebras are conjugate by a unitary arbitrarily close to the identity. The tolerance depends only on the prescribed distance of that unitary from the identity, uniformly over all algebras, representations, and Hilbert spaces. This resolves the strong Kadison–Kastler conjecture.
family_title: Strong Kadison–Kastler stability and its spatial boundaries

review.reason: Proves that close von Neumann algebras are conjugate by a unitary near the identity.
